goal: You're here to judge whether an organisation publicly committed to something and then lobbied in a way that contradicts that commitment.

steps.title: Load what each organisation asked government for
steps.prose: The ask half: real advocacy records, each read off a published page.
steps.data_description: Every advocacy record in the sample, as the file lists it.

steps.title: Load each organisation's public promise
steps.prose: The other half: what each organisation said in public it would do. Each organisation appears once, and a repeat stops the run.

steps.title: Refuse a claim with no source
steps.prose: A record with no link, no ask or no date stops the run here rather than reaching the report.
steps.data_description: The same records, each carrying a link a reader can open.

steps.title: Put each promise beside the ask
steps.prose: Nothing is dropped: a blank promise means none is on record for that organisation, and the absence IS the record.
steps.data_description: Every record, plus its organisation's public promise.

steps.title: Judge the ask against the promise
steps.prose: A model proposes how the two stand and writes one sentence saying why. Trust this step least — read both texts yourself.
steps.data_description: The same records, plus the model's label and its one sentence.

steps.title: Put every contradiction in front of a person
steps.prose: The model's label is only a proposal: every contradiction it flagged waits here for a person to keep or change, under their own name.
steps.data_description: Every record, plus the label a person left on the proposed contradictions.

steps.title: Publish the report
steps.prose: What you hand to someone who was not here — open it under Published. Each row links to both its sources and back to the record it came from.
steps.data_description: One row per record, as published.
